subject: Post-demo: data boundaries, subprocessor roster & security questionnaire (MedCorp)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medcorphealth.com>; Tom Brennan <tom.brennan@medcorphealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: data boundaries, subprocessor roster & security questionnaire (MedCorp)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

- Scope we covered: inference hosting options (Hosted API vs Dedicated), data-in-transit protections, expected PII patterns in requests, and typical data retention controls.
- Security items you asked us to follow up on: SOC 2 status, how we handle GDPR/HIPAA requests, and a complete subprocessor (third-party) roster for cloud and telemetry services.
- Action items (owners):
  1) Jasmine: share our security questionnaire template and the call recording.
  2) Sarah/Tom: confirm which data classes (PHI/Pseudonymized/PII) will travel to the inference API and share any internal data-flow diagrams you want reviewed.
  3) Ben/Karthik: standby to provide a preliminary pricing estimate for a Dedicated pool if required.

Attachments: redwood_call_recording_20280724.mp4 (call recording stub); redwood_initial_sq_template.xlsx (security questionnaire template).

Open question for your team: do you require a SOC 2 Type II report or is a SOC 2 Type I + current control evidence acceptable as an interim? Knowing that will speed evidence delivery.

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes follow-up with security and engineering to validate data flows — I can schedule for Thursday if that works.

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medcorphealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data boundaries, subprocessor roster & security questionnaire (MedCorp)

Thanks Jasmine — solid summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Data classes: primarily PHI-derived telemetry (pseudonymized where possible) + standard patient metadata. We will share a redacted data-flow diagram by end of day Wednesday.
- SOC 2: MedCorp requires SOC 2 Type II for production access. We need a copy of your most recent report and the date range it covers. If Type II isn’t available yet, please provide the Type I report plus any complementary control evidence and a roadmap to Type II.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We are subject to HIPAA; please state how Redwood supports BAAs and whether your Private deployment offering supports customer-managed KMS/HSM.

We have attached our security questionnaire (filled for initial sections) to help accelerate the process: medcorp_completed_sq.pdf (stub).

Can we kick off a focused technical walk-through with your security engineering team on Thursday, Jul 27 at 11:00 AM ET? That would help validate subprocessor boundaries and encryption key flows.

Thanks,

Sarah Liu
Data Protection Officer
MedCorp Health
security@medcorphealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: data boundaries, subprocessor roster & security questionnaire (MedCorp)

Sarah — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for the completed sections.

Quick answers and next steps: 
- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31. I'll coordinate delivery with our security team (expect an encrypted transfer via secure file link by EOD Friday).
- BAA & KMS: Redwood supports BAAs; our Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS and HSM integrations. I'll loop in our Security Engineering lead on the Thursday call to confirm key rotation and access controls.
- Subprocessor roster: attached below is our current public subprocessor list for the components relevant to inference and logging (compute, object storage, telemetry). If you need a more detailed mapping to specific data flows we can produce a matrix for the Thursday session.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20280724.csv (stub), redwood_call_recording_20280724.mp4 (repeat).

Scheduling: Thursday, Jul 27 at 11:00 AM ET conflicts with your timezone — did you mean Jul 27 at 11:00 AM ET (which is 8:00 AM PT)? We have 11:00 AM ET available and will set the meeting once you confirm.

Next actions: 
1) Jasmine to share SOC 2 Type II by secure link (EOD Fri).
2) Sarah to confirm whether MedCorp wants the full subprocessor-to-dataflow matrix prior to the call or if the high-level roster is sufficient for initial review.
3) Ben to produce a Dedicated pool cost estimate if MedCorp confirms Dedicated in-region isolation.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
